# Sanchala School of Bharatanatyam

> The subtle beauty and fluid grace of the Vazhuvoor style, taught by Smt. Radhika Kalyani in a relaxed, non-competitive class.

Website: https://sanchala.in/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98405 73668

## Contact
- Sanchala School of Bharatanatyam · 'Kalyan', No. 1, Kellys Lane, Kilpauk, Chennai 600 010 · Near Kellys Telephone Exchange · +91 98405 73668 · 044 2647 1390 · radhika_rajasenan@hotmail.com

## Key facts
- Sanchala founded 2002
- 100 students and more
- chosen best dancer, Tamilnadu Eyal Isai Nataka Manram 1976

## Facilities
- Basic lessons: adavus
- Intermediate Bharatanatyam
- Advanced classes
- Beginner classes, Mon–Wed
- Intermediate, Tue–Thu
- Individual classes, Friday
- Senior classes, weekends
- Theory of Bharatanatyam
- Regular performances

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Sanchala School of Bharatanatyam?
'Kalyan', No. 1, Kellys Lane, Kilpauk, Chennai 600 010 (Near Kellys Telephone Exchange).

### What facilities does Sanchala School of Bharatanatyam have?
Basic lessons: adavus, Intermediate Bharatanatyam, Advanced classes, Beginner classes, Mon–Wed, Intermediate, Tue–Thu, Individual classes, Friday, Senior classes, weekends, Theory of Bharatanatyam, Regular performances.

### When are classes held?
Beginners Monday to Wednesday from 4 pm, intermediate Tuesday and Thursday 5 to 7 pm, individual classes on Friday, and senior classes on weekends.

### What style do you teach?
The Vazhuvoor style of Bharatanatyam.

### How do I join Sanchala School of Bharatanatyam?
Pick a date on this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 98405 73668.
